signature.name: VTask.VanishingDiam
signature.type: {β : Type u_1} -> {α : Type u_2} -> (A : List β → Set α) -> [PseudoMetricSpace α] -> Prop

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: VanishingDiam is a universally quantified Prop with no junk-value or boundary conventions; it is well-defined for every scheme A on every pseudo-metric space without any special case treatment.

facts.statement: ∀ {β α : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace α] (A : List β → Set α), VTask.VanishingDiam A ↔ ∀ (x : ℕ → β), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Metric.ediam (A (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => x i)))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

facts.statement: ∀ {β α : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace α] (A B : List β → Set α), VTask.VanishingDiam A → (∀ l : List β, B l ⊆ A l) → VTask.VanishingDiam B
